description:
For people interested in using Apertium models for translation.

The app automatically updates itself monthly from the Apertium GitHub repository. Language pairs are delivered on demand as App Store On-Demand Resources (ODR) — each pair downloads only when you pick it.

The app works offline once language pairs are installed.

The "Trunk" and "Staging" categories of language pairs are supported. The language pair choices listed below are automatically updated monthly.
